operators.label: Add Constraint
operators.description: Add a constraint to the active bone

items.name: Copy Location
items.description: Copy the location of a target (with an optional offset), so that they move together

items.name: Copy Rotation
items.description: Copy the rotation of a target (with an optional offset), so that they rotate together

items.name: Copy Scale
items.description: Copy the scale factors of a target (with an optional offset), so that they are scaled by the same amount

items.name: Copy Transforms
items.description: Copy all the transformations of a target, so that they move together

items.name: Limit Distance
items.description: Restrict movements to within a certain distance of a target (at the time of constraint evaluation only)

items.name: Limit Location
items.description: Restrict movement along each axis within given ranges

items.name: Limit Rotation
items.description: Restrict rotation along each axis within given ranges

items.name: Limit Scale
items.description: Restrict scaling along each axis with given ranges

items.name: Maintain Volume
items.description: Compensate for scaling one axis by applying suitable scaling to the other two axes

items.name: Transformation
items.description: Use one transform property from target to control another (or same) property on owner

items.name: Transform Cache
items.description: Look up the transformation matrix from an external file

items.name: Clamp To
items.description: Restrict movements to lie along a curve by remapping location along curve's longest axis

items.name: Damped Track
items.description: Point towards a target by performing the smallest rotation necessary

items.name: Inverse Kinematics
items.description: Control a chain of bones by specifying the endpoint target (Bones only)

items.name: Locked Track
items.description: Rotate around the specified ('locked') axis to point towards a target

items.name: Spline IK
items.description: Align chain of bones along a curve (Bones only)

items.name: Stretch To
items.description: Stretch along Y-Axis to point towards a target

items.name: Track To
items.description: Legacy tracking constraint prone to twisting artifacts

items.name: Action
items.description: Use transform property of target to look up pose for owner from an Action

items.name: Armature
items.description: Apply weight-blended transformation from multiple bones like the Armature modifier

items.name: Child Of
items.description: Make target the 'detachable' parent of owner

items.name: Floor
items.description: Use position (and optionally rotation) of target to define a 'wall' or 'floor' that the owner cannot cross

items.name: Follow Path
items.description: Use to animate an object/bone following a path

items.name: Geometry Attribute
items.description: Retrieve transform from target geometry attribute data

items.name: Pivot
items.description: Change pivot point for transforms (buggy)

items.name: Shrinkwrap
items.description: Restrict movements to surface of target mesh
